method: lattice sampling at 0.001 degrees (~110 m at the default), shares below 0.04 dropped as slivers

sources.council_districts: NYC Open Data 872g-cjhh (shoreline-clipped, for areal shares)
sources.community_districts: NYC Open Data 5crt-au7u (joint interest areas excluded)

note: Shares are approximate and are of sampled land area within the council district. They may sum to less than 1 where water or unsampled gaps fall inside the district. Ordering is stable; treat the numbers as indicative.
